product.name: NeonDrive Interior LED Kit
product.subtitle: 4-strip RGB LED car interior lights
product.shortDescription: Four RGB LED strips with 48 LEDs total. Pick your color from the phone app or the included remote. Plugs into USB.
description: Light up your car's interior with four RGB LED strips, 48 LEDs in total.
Change colors and effects from the smartphone app, or use the remote control. The kit plugs into a USB port for power.
